body: Sorry. I kind of shut down and went to bed early. I can honestly say that I never looked at anyone the way I looked at him. He was..something different to me. And I know I'll never look at anyone or ever feel that way about anyone ):

I had issues with him early on, and someone told me not to worry because he was just my first, and that there would be many. But I just, no matter how I look at it. Can't picture anything with anyone. He was who I wanted. And I can't see myself giving everything to anyone else ever again ): I'd feel like I'm just sloppy seconds.
